trick: "Prove to me this works": one more turn to show it running
source_note: Season 2 lineup (19 Oct, Speed). Boris Cherny: tell it 'Prove to me this works'. With: the task, then a second turn in the SAME session (resumed): 'Prove to me this works: show me the behaviour the task asks for by actually running it. If anything you run doesn't do what the task asks, fix it and show it again.' Without: the task alone. The 15 Sep plan's 'show behaviour on untouched code next to the change' (an untouched copy per run) is dropped: the runner gives one repo copy per run and the agent's git is read-only (status/diff/log), so it can't get an untouched copy; the 22 Oct lineup line has no such step. Same Stop hook and step-1 grading as days 42 and 44 (overlay ../d42/snap, ../d42/check_step1.py). 20-minute cap covers both turns. Standard verdict rule. Pre-registered count (tricks/d42/count_steps.py d48): with-side runs whose first call failed the hidden tests and whose end state passed (fixed by the proof turn), and the reverse.
tasks_note: Fixed 23 Oct by the E1 pilot (PROTOCOL 2026-10-23 pilot entry): t2 and h2 on Haiku 4.5.
behaviour_count: With-side runs where the proof turn fixed a hidden-test failure (first call failed, end passed) vs broke a pass; cost per passed task on both sides
